SELECT id FROM bp_menu WHERE is_deleted = 0 and id like
CONCAT(#{item},'%')

SELECT distinct t1.id, t1.name, t1.parent_id, t1.sort, !ISNULL(t2.role_id) flag FROM bp_menu t1 left join bp_role_menu t2 on t1.id=t2.menu_id and t2.role_id = #{roleId} WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.is_menu = #{notMenu} and t1.code like concat(#{menuId},"%") ORDER BY t1.sort
SELECT id,name terminal_name FROM bp_menu WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort

SELECT distinct t3.id, t3.name, t3.sort, t3.parent_id, t3.is_menu FROM bp_user_role t1 JOIN bp_role_menu t2 ON t1.role_id = t2.role_id JOIN bp_menu t3 ON t2.menu_id = t3.id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t3.is_deleted = 0 AND t1.user_id = #{userId}
and t3.id <= #{idRange}

SELECT t3.id, t3.name, t3.sort, t3.parent_id, t3.outside_url, t3.is_outside, t3.is_menu, t3.alias, t3.icon from bp_menu t3 WHERE t3.is_deleted = 0
and (t3.code like concat(#{dto.rootMenuCode},'%') or t3.id <= #{idRange})
and t3.is_menu = 1
and t3.terminal_type = #{dto.terminalType}
SELECT id, name, parent_id, is_menu, sort FROM bp_menu WHERE is_deleted = 0 and is_menu = true ORDER BY sort

SELECT distinct t1.id, t1.name, t1.parent_id, t1.sort, !ISNULL(t2.role_id) flag FROM bp_menu t1 left join bp_auth_role_menu t2 on t1.id=t2.menu_id and t2.role_id = #{roleId} WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.is_menu = #{notMenu} and t1.code like concat(#{menuId},"%") ORDER BY t1.sort
